character_lock: Reem is the same four-year-old Arab girl in every image: warm medium skin, large dark-brown friendly eyes, round cheeks, dark-brown hair tied into two short low pigtails with muted teal bands, lavender long-sleeve pajamas with tiny plain gold dots, and no headscarf. She is always calm or gently smiling, never resistant, sad, afraid, or frustrated, and never shows teeth. Her mother is the same gentle Arab woman in every image: warm medium skin, kind dark eyes, modest dusty-lavender hijab and long muted-teal home dress, calm face, no visible teeth. The same three toy types recur unchanged and never duplicate: exactly one small honey-brown teddy bear whose face contains ONLY two friendly button-like eyes and one tiny plain oval nose; the area below the nose is completely blank fur with absolutely no mouth line, smile, muzzle curve, tongue, or teeth; exactly one muted coral ball with a single cream stripe; and exactly six rounded wooden blocks total in teal, gold, coral and cream. Never add a second ball, second teddy, extra block, or toy-like background duplicate. Whenever blocks are stored, their rounded block box is fully opaque with no window, cutout, transparency, or opening that reveals blocks. The bedroom stays consistent: warm cream walls, low pale-wood shelf, woven toy basket, rounded block box, low bed with lavender blanket, and one window.
